question: Which edition of 'Khelo India Youth Games' was held in June 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Fourth**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The 'Khelo India Youth Games' is an initiative by the Indian government to promote sports and youth engagement in sports activities across the country.
 
• The fourth edition of the 'Khelo India Youth Games' was held in June 2022.
 
• The event aims to identify and nurture young sporting talents who can represent India in international sports events.
 
• The Khelo India program was introduced by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports in 2018.</l
